label: LZ 4.2 tonne-year WIMP search reported no excess
summary: In its 4.2 tonne-year WIMP dark-matter search, LUX-ZEPLIN reported no evidence for an excess over expected backgrounds after removal of artificial signal-like events injected to mitigate analyzer bias.

sources.title: Dark Matter Search Results from 4.2 Tonne-Years of Exposure of the LUX-ZEPLIN (LZ) Experiment
